plugins.name: code-review-local
plugins.description: Local code review using multiple parallel agents with confidence scoring. Like Anthropic's official /code-review plugin, but operates on a local jj revset or git refspec instead of a GitHub pull request — findings are posted back into the chat. Read-only: never modifies the repository.

plugins.name: pipeline
plugins.description: A gated task pipeline as skills for jj repositories tracked in plan docs: gap report, spec with a one-screen brief, vertical-slice implementation, two-axis wrap-up review, decision maps, device test rounds. Calls Matt Pocock's thinking skills; replaces his pipeline skills.
